## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, both models agree, and all five similar cases are Benign.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, others <1% | Sharply peaked |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 76th percentile | No quality concern |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Benign | Full agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↓ invasive · Prominent glands; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 5, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Abundant benign stroma; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Scarce infiltrating stroma; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score; concept model associates it with higher invasive likelihood · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion-test CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit); heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion-test CI includes 0 (+0.002); concept explanation not shown to reflect the classifier. No Unreliable concept leads here.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration was tested on only 132 images; probability near 100% may be overconfident.
- Tubule concept failed caption consistency; its association may be weaker than the 18/20 spot check suggests.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 4**: confirm gland architecture is benign, without atypical cell crowding.
2. **Regions 5, 8, 10**: confirm benign stroma or fat, with no infiltrating tumor cells.
3. **Region 0**: check ducts for atypical cells; this concept is weakly associated with invasive here.
